testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-hyperlinks-navigation-of-email-a-friend-see-more-power-tools-on-pdp.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify hyperlinks navigation of email a friend & see more power tools on pdp

scenario.summary: Registered user signs in, opens a product's PDP by SKU, follows the See More (category) button to the category listing, then reopens the PDP, opens Email A Friend, checks the modal and the required-email validation, and sends the product to a friend's email address.
steps: Sign in on the webstore with the test-data username and password (empty storageState).
Search the product SKU and open the result; assert breadcrumb and product heading.
Click See More; on the category listing assert the category heading and that a first product is visible.
Search and reopen the PDP; assert breadcrumb and heading again.
Open Email A Friend; assert the modal heading, the Friend's Email Address label and the Send Mail button.
Submit empty to get 'Email is required.'; fill the receiver email and submit; assert 'Email sent successfully.'.
stateChanges: Sends one Email A Friend message about the product to the receiver address (an outgoing email; no database record the test reads back).
assertions: Breadcrumb equals Home/<category path>/<product name>; heading equals the product name (twice).
See More opens the listing of the product's category (heading equals seeMoreCategory) with at least one product.
Email A Friend modal: heading 'email a friend', Friend's Email Address label, 'Send Mail' button.
Empty submit shows 'Email is required.'; a valid address shows 'Email sent successfully.'.
evidence: Title 'verify hyperlinks navigation of email a friend & see more power tools on pdp' and step labels '1) See More Power Tools -> category listing', '2) Email A Friend - modal, validation, send' match the flow.
Spec lines 27-28 sign in with data.username / data.password (masked in the scan): declared account USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED, preferred required, credentials stay in the test data (role credential).

Profile: productSKU z-1234579 FOUND as BundleProduct, active, PRODUCTION, inventory 28362, storefront index 1; productName matches 2 rows. The product type is incidental; PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK keeps today's record as the preferred one.

Missing output: productCategory (Tools / Power Tools) and seeMoreCategory (Power Tools, the category the See More button opens) are the product's category path and category name; no product key returns a category name or path (PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK outputs: sku, name, productId, price, addOnProductId, addOnName).

receiverEmail (masked) is a recipient address the test types, not an environment record: role config. The masked literal at spec line 58 is the label text "Friend's Email Address" (masked by the email key-name rule): role expected-output, kept masked.
The send step needs the store to have outgoing email configured; that is environment configuration, not a vocabulary key.
strategy migrate: loadData is used, but productCategory and seeMoreCategory (data values in assertions) map to no output of PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK, so swap rule 2 fails.
